children: Sweden digital solutions provider's Q3 net sales rose 23% yr/yr to SEK 231 mln
Adjusted EBITA margin for Q3 slipped to 12.9% from 13.5% last year
Company posted Q3 operating loss of SEK 8 mln, with negative earnings per share
Company did not provide specific guidance for future quarters or the full year in the press release
RECURRING SOFTWARE REVENUE - Co said recurring net revenue from software rose to SEK 270 mln LTM from SEK 217 mln
EMPLOYEE GROWTH - Co said average number of employees during Q3 increased to 660 from 596 last yr
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Exsitec Holding AB is SEK164.00, about 49.1% above its October 19 closing price of SEK110.00
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 12 three months ago
